exit 0
--- stdout
Read a supported config key. Equivalent to liza get <key>, e.g. liza get config.post_worktree_cmd; an unset post_worktree_cmd is null in JSON.
Usage:
liza config get <key> [flags]
Flags:
--format string Output format: json, yaml, table, value (default "value")
-h, --help help for get
--json output result as structured JSON
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
